Thanks for the ping — I reviewed the attached DPA and put our suggestions in Redlined_DPA_Redwood_v1.docx. High-level notes: 

- Data deletion (section 7): FinTechCo's 90-day requirement is uncommon for our hosted product; our standard is 30 days. Recommend counteroffer: accept 60 days for controller-to-controller customers or add a limited exception for historical backups/forensic hold with a 90-day purge after release.
- SCCs: the supplied controller/controller SCCs are fine; we should append the annexes with our subprocessors list.
- Liability cap: propose keeping existing contract cap language; flag if customer pushes higher cap.
- Audits/Access: limit to security questionnaires and SOC 2 evidence; decline on-site access unless pre-approved.

Signature routing recommendation: DocuSign powerform -> Contracts team (contracts@redwoodinference.com) to validate -> CFO or delegated signatory if deal value > $250k; for smaller deals AM (Karthik) can execute on behalf of Sales. If FinTechCo needs countersignature, require procurement to sign and upload final signed copy to HubSpot.

I've attached the redline. If everyone agrees, I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and include the redlined DPA as the signing document.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
